label: Ask Before Changes
description: Claude browses your code without asking, but asks permission before making any changes.
detail: Auto-approves: reading files, searching code, inspecting directories and git history, system info. You approve: file edits, running any command that modifies state.

label: Auto-Edit
description: Claude browses and edits files without asking. Still asks before running dev tools and git operations.
detail: Auto-approves: everything above, plus creating/editing/copying/moving files. You approve: build commands, test runners, git commits/pushes.

label: Full Autonomy
description: Claude runs development commands without asking. Still asks before destructive operations.
detail: Auto-approves: everything above, plus git, package managers, compilers, build tools, test runners, linters, Docker, and web access. You approve: rm, sudo, force pushes, hard resets.
